bakery.title: Bakery
bakery.about: A domed clay oven with its chimney, a lime-white bakehouse under a planted roof, bread on the counter.

battery.title: Battery
battery.about: Four ceramic cells on a timber deck, joined by copper bars. The charge rings are separate pieces for the game to light.

beehive.title: Beehive
beehive.about: Three stacked hives in soft colours on a timber stand, with a planter of flowers for the bees.

bench.title: Bench
bench.about: A timber bench between two terracotta pots: somewhere to sit and look at the farm.

cannery.title: Cannery
cannery.about: A big copper kettle on a tiled stove, steam off its pipe, red jars on a rack under a solar awning.

composter.title: Composter
composter.about: Three slatted timber bins from fresh cuttings to dark compost, a ceramic tumbler on a frame, a barrow and sacks.

coop.title: Coop
coop.about: A long rounded henhouse under a planted roof with a solar sheet, a pop-hole and ramp, and a run with an open gate arch.

crates.title: Crates
crates.about: A stack of harvest crates with a sack and a jar: yard dressing.

depot.title: Depot
depot.about: A stone platform with a rounded office and a cargo canopy, a ramp, a landing ring and a mooring mast for the airship.

digester.title: Digester
digester.about: A round tank under a planted dome: farm waste in at the hopper, gas to the copper bell, a small flare on its pipe.

farmhouse.title: Farmhouse
farmhouse.about: A rounded two-storey house under a planted roof, a sunroom under solar glass, a vine pergola, a rain tank off the roof.

garage.title: Garage
garage.about: An open-fronted timber shelter for the truck: boarded walls, a barrel roof half planted and half solar, a charging post.

greenhouse.title: Greenhouse
greenhouse.about: A long barrel of sea-glass panes on a low timber wall, timber ribs, a copper ridge with two vent hoods, a glazed door.

lantern.title: Lantern
lantern.about: A solar lantern on a timber post: a small solar cap, a copper arm, a globe for the game to light at dusk.

loom.title: Loom
loom.about: A big timber loom in the open, striped linen growing down it, bolts of cloth on a rack, a rounded store behind.

mill.title: Mill
mill.about: A hopper up a slim timber tower, millstones turning in the open at its foot, flour running into a sack.

oil_press.title: Oil press
oil_press.about: A timber screw press with a copper handwheel, golden oil running to a jar, and a small store with a shelf of oil.

planter.title: Planters
planter.about: Two raised timber beds of herbs and flowers and a copper watering can: yard dressing.

pylon.title: Pylon
pylon.about: A slim timber pole with ceramic insulators, a copper cap and a small lamp. Quiet: a farm has many.

rain_tank.title: Rain tank
rain_tank.about: A ceramic rain tank on stone feet, with a copper downpipe, a tap and a bucket.

silo.title: Silo
silo.about: A ceramic grain store: copper hoops, a planted cap, a gauge window showing how full it is, and a filling pipe.

solar_panel.title: Solar panel
solar_panel.about: One sheet of solar glass on two copper posts, low and quiet; the meadow grows under it.

spinner.title: Spinner
spinner.about: A great spinning wheel in the open, bobbins of dyed thread under a solar awning, a round wool store behind.

sprinkler.title: Sprinkler
sprinkler.about: A copper riser on a ceramic valve, taller than a person. The two-armed head is a separate piece, ready to spin.

truck.title: Truck
truck.about: A small electric farm truck: a rounded ceramic cab with solar glass on its roof and an open timber bed.

water_wheel.title: Water wheel
water_wheel.about: A ten-paddle wheel hung over the river off the front of its bank, a copper dynamo on its shaft, a generator house behind.

weather_station.title: Weather station
weather_station.about: A louvred white instrument box under a planted lid, a copper mast with vane and spinning cups, and a rain gauge.

wind_turbine.title: Wind turbine
wind_turbine.about: A slim ceramic tower, a rotor ten metres across with terracotta tips. The rotor is a separate piece, ready to turn.
